command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
# No credentials are needed or wanted: every asset href is rewritten to a local staged
# file, so GDAL never reaches for S3 and the container never needs IMDS.
export AWS_NO_SIGN_REQUEST=YES GDAL_DISABLE_READDIR_ON_OPEN=EMPTY_DIR
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).

echo "== staged bytes must match their pin =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: identities.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

echo "== the scene must have arrived =="
for f in SCL.tif B01.tif item.json; do
  test -s "/tmp/$f" || { echo "FAIL: /tmp/$f missing or empty"; exit 1; }
  printf "  %-12s %12s bytes\n" "$f" "$(stat -c %s "/tmp/$f")"
done

# python3 -u so a killed run still has its output in command.log.
python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee identities.log
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
